narr: A typical summertime pattern prevailed with scattered afternoon thunderstorms across portions of southwest and south-central Georgia. There were a few reports of wind damage with the strongest storms. In addition, pockets of flash flooding were observed in Albany due to very heavy rainfall in excess of 3 inches in 1 hour.
ev: Flooding was reported in the 2500 block of Whispering Pines Road.
A car was stalled in flood waters near the 100 block of Collins Street.
A couple of roads in the southeastern part of Lee county had water running over them during a 30 minute period of heavy rainfall.
